title: Comments
summary: Threaded comments on any record, with replies, @mentions, edits and live updates.
description: Adds a comment table attached to one of your tables (tasks, posts, lessons, listings) and a CommentThread component: replies nest under the comment they answer, typing @ suggests people to mention, authors can edit and delete their own comments, and new comments appear for everyone without a refresh. People are told in-app when they are mentioned or someone replies to them. Staff get a moderation list.

params.name: attach_to
params.label: Comment on
params.description: The table whose records people comment on.

params.name: author_role
params.label: Who comments
params.description: The role whose people write comments (their own table is the author).

params.name: org_field
params.label: Organisation (optional)
params.description: Optional: the ref on that table naming its organisation (from organisations-and-teams). Comments then belong to that organisation and only its members read them.

notes: The commenting role needs its own table (an entity named like the role).

includes: Table comment: subject, parent, author, body, mentions
A Discussion page and a staff moderation list
One workflow: notify mentions and replies
highlights: Server-stamped author: nobody comments as someone else
Rules: no empty comments, replies stay in their thread
